title: Forest Hermitage Accounts
kicker: The Forest Hermitage Trust · Forest Hermitage (Wat Pah Santidhamma) · Lower Fulbrook, Warwickshire
costDefShort: total expenditure in the Trust's accounts, without depreciation (wear on buildings, a vehicle and equipment, which is not money paid out).
defs: Running costs: the total expenditure in the accounts of The Forest Hermitage Trust, without depreciation (wear on the buildings, a vehicle and equipment, not money paid out). The community lists give no count of residents for Forest Hermitage. Inflation: the UK consumer prices index (ONS), averaged over each April-to-March year. All amounts in pounds, as paid at the time, unless the page says "in today's money".
holdLede: The accounts also give cash and net assets at 31 March each year.
holdSub: At 31 March. Net assets: everything the Trust owns less what it owes; the buildings and land are most of it.
cardNote: Totals only (no cost lines on this page), 2019–2026.
sources: Sources anyone can check: the Trust's accounts at Companies House (company 10368008) and the Charity Commission register (charity 1173083). Updated __UPDATED__
incomeNote: Income moves a lot from year to year; the data used here do not say why.
meaningNote: The accounts list the costs line by line (repairs, heat and light, council tax, depreciation and so on), but this page shows the totals only.
holdNote: Tangible assets (mostly the buildings) were £617,432 of £892,933 net assets in 2026, and £512,186 of the funds are restricted to the building (the same in every year).
notes: Where the figures come from. The Forest Hermitage Trust (charity 1173083, company 10368008) files its accounts at Companies House. The page uses the accounts for the years to 31 March 2019 to 2026 (accounts/ in this folder). They are scanned pages: the figures were read from the scans, and for 2021 to 2025 they agree with the Charity Commission register as shown on OpenCharities (opencharities_1173083.json).

The Buddha-Dhamma Fellowship. Until April 2019 the monastery's money was held by the Buddha-Dhamma Fellowship (charity 289913, registered 1984). On 10 April 2019 the Fellowship transferred responsibility for the monastery, its assets and its debts to the Trust, and the Fellowship's later receipts and payments for the monastery are counted in the Trust's accounts. The Fellowship's own accounts before 2022 are not on the Charity Commission register or OpenCharities and are not used here, so the page starts in 2019.

The year to March 2019 is the comparison column of the 2020 accounts, which combine the Trust and the Fellowship. The Trust's own filing for that year (a short micro-company account) is much smaller and is not used.
Years. The Trust's year runs from 1 April to 31 March and is named by the year it ends in: "2026" is April 2025 to March 2026.

Running costs. Total expenditure less depreciation: buildings, a motor vehicle and equipment. The accounts list the costs line by line each year (building maintenance and repairs, heat and light, council tax, insurance, monks' welfare, bursaries, travel and so on); this page does not show them yet.
Not in the accounts. The work of volunteers and gifts of food are not given a value.
Residents. The community lists have no section for Forest Hermitage, so there is no count of residents and no comparison with residents on this page.
